notes: STYLE-1 MONTH/WEEK CONFLICT, RESOLVED FROM THE PAGE'S OWN EXAMPLE: the page text labels style-1 positions 4-5 'month', but its own example serial E072514528 yields 25 in those positions, which is not a month; it decodes as week 25, year 2007. Style-1 is therefore shipped as year+week, identical in decode to style-2 (same pattern and positions, Tempstar-file precedent for duplicate ICP letter+9-digit styles). If a distinct month-based Arcoaire system is ever documented, style-1 must be revisited; as shipped, no style in this file mis-decodes another shipped style's serials because styles 1 and 2 decode identically. No parent or sister claim is made: the fetched page states none.

styles.era: Letter followed by 9 digits (page labels positions 4-5 month; example decodes as week)
styles.notes: Page positions 2-3 = year digits (1-based); positions 4-5 are shipped as week because the page example's value there is 25. Page example E072514528.

styles.era: Letter (normally L or G) followed by 9 digits
styles.notes: Page positions 2-3 = year, 4-5 = week (1-based). Identical pattern and positions to style-1, so it never wins first-match, but its decode is identical. Page example L920671787.

styles.era: 10-character format, week-year in first four digits
styles.notes: Page positions 1-2 = week, 3-4 = year (1-based). Page example 4102G12345.
